SDE Intern

About us:

Hiver is a modern, AI-driven customer service platform used by companies across healthcare, finance, logistics, education, and technology. We help teams deliver fast, human support across email, chat, phone, WhatsApp, and more — without the complexity of legacy helpdesks.

We’re a challenger brand in a category dominated by over-engineered tools. We build software that is simple, powerful, and genuinely helpful, and we operate internally with that same philosophy. If you want meaningful ownership, thoughtful teammates, and work that ships, Hiver is a great place to do it.

Opportunity:

As an SDE Intern at Hiver, you will have an exciting opportunity to kickstart your career and gain valuable hands-on experience in building and supporting our product. During your internship, you will work closely with our team of experienced engineers to design, build, and ship features that impact real customers. We are growing rapidly and handle a substantial amount of email traffic daily for our users, so you’ll gain exposure to complex technical challenges and learn how high-quality software is built and operated in production.
